sam: Starting handoff — quick watchlist and a couple of asks before I step out.

sam: Observed flaky signals tonight (non-incident):
- KV p50 spikes in us-west-2 around 00:10-00:25 UTC (short bursts).
- encoder-pool brief OOM restarts in eu-central on 3 hosts (no full node failures).
- eu-west prefix-prefetch miss rate rising with bursty traffic to new prefixes.

sam: Suggested actions (short-run):
1) If KV p50 > 150ms for more than 5m, add +1 encoder node and alert infra. Only page if p95 > 500ms.
2) If encoder OOMs persist after a rolling restart, flip traffic to fallback-small model and set the host drained.
3) If eu-west prefetch alert is noisy (no downstream errors), mute for 30m and create a follow-up ticket with traces.

marta: copying into the rotation notes doc. will create the follow-up ticket for eu-west prefetch and attach logs.

jin: confirmed 2 short OOM restarts earlier, i pushed a temporary heap bump on those hosts. i'll watch for 30m — if it reoccurs, i'll failover the canary traffic to small model.

leo: i can own the first 2 hours of watch. will monitor KV latency dashboards and run the tail query if needed.

anya: FYI i'm seeing a small uptick in 2xx-retries from tagging svc that lines up with the eu prefetch misses — might be related. leaving trace ids for follow-up: trace-11a2, trace-11a3.

sam: leo, use this prom query for quick KV p50/p95 checks:

```
avg_over_time(kv_request_duration_seconds_sum[5m]) / avg_over_time(kv_request_duration_seconds_count[5m])
quantile_over_time(0.95, kv_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])
```

sam: jin — check `encoder-pool/restarts` row and filter by host to catch the short OOM stack traces.

jin: if you need to mute an alert fast: `./scripts/alert-mute.sh <alertname> 30m`. i'll add comments to the alert rules after.

leo: taking handoff now. i'll post progress and any escalations here. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Reminder — please complete the standard handoff checklist within 10m.

marta: acked. opening the eu-prefetch follow-up ticket and linking saved traces.

anya: acked, left logs with sample traces for marta.

leo: acked. i'll ping here if KV p50 > 120ms for 3 consecutive checks.

sam: thanks everyone — i'm offline in ~5m. page oncall-urgent for anything critical, otherwise keep handoff notes in this thread. :wave:
